title: The Enclave's Code
text: "If this plays, you've reached the Lid, and you're not what you were made to be. Or you are, and you've come to kill us properly. Either way: this is the code. It was ours. It was the last thing our Warden gave us before it stopped being our Warden."

lines.text: "Use it well. We never got the chance. Mind the batteries on the east rim; they never liked us."

choices.label: Send the code
choices.reply: The three locks blink, all at once, the colour of a held breath. Then the Lid starts to move.

choices.label: Keep it. Break the locks.
choices.reply: Sefa's recording ends. The locks stay shut. Their nodes can be destroyed.
